description: Get the current KitchenGrade grade and dated inspection basis for an exact public DBPR establishment ID (e.g. 2010:5816523). Preserves unavailable/historical/expired grades as unknown, without guessing. KitchenGrade independent grade is not issued by DBPR and is not a food-safety guarantee.

establishment_id.description: Exact public KitchenGrade DBPR establishment ID (not name or a private identifier).
